description: The ENTSO-E Transmission System Map is the interactive map of the high-voltage network operated by the members of the European Network of Transmission System Operators for Electricity. The map page, read on 2026-09-26, states that it is an illustration of the transmission system and shows existing elements and those under construction: power plants, converters, substations, and high-voltage lines and cables. It warns that network elements are not placed at their exact geographic location, so the map is schematic. PDF versions of the map are offered on a separate grid map downloads page. Coverage is the synchronous areas served by ENTSO-E members across Europe. No licence or update date is stated on the page read, and the interactive layer is script-rendered, so its layer list was not read. Caveats: positions are approximate, and elements are not published as a machine-readable network model. Simulation uses are checking the topology of open grid models such as PyPSA-Eur or SciGRID against the operators' own map and locating interconnectors and planned lines. Related records: data-entsoe-transparency-platform holds the operational data of the same operators.
